name: zrndr_set_palette_remap_key_from_rgb01
description: zRndr_SetPaletteRemapKeyFromRgb01 builds a temporary black-to-RGB palette-remap recipe and forwards it to zRndr_SetPaletteRemapKey.
tier_s_evidence: VC5SP3 profile vc5_o2_ob0_md_facs produced symbol ?zRndr_SetPaletteRemapKeyFromRgb01@@YIXPAUzColorRgb@@M@Z with zero unmasked byte mismatches for 0x499990 after COFF relocation masking (8 relocation bytes, 9 trim nops; BN size 103, VC size 112).
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x499990 shows null rgb01 disables active remap, otherwise it builds a stack recipe with color0 black at strength 0, color1 from rgb01 at strength 1, and forwards shadeLevel01 to zRndr_SetPaletteRemapKey.
The native smoke verifies RGB recipe lookup and remap key packing through the RGB forwarding helper.
